description: This file implements the core logic for managing 'talk mode' within an iOS app, including speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, push-to-talk handling, and communication with external chat and TTS services. It encompasses classes, methods, and functions to coordinate microphone input, process transcripts, manage incremental speech, handle various speech output formats, and interface with gateway services for chat responses.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container class for capturing and retrieving errors occurring during streaming.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for controlling the talk mode functionality, including speech recognition, TTS, push-to-talk, and chat interaction coordination.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Associates a gateway session for chat and event handling.

methods.name: updateGatewayConnected
methods.description: Updates internal state based on gateway connection status; triggers recognition start if connected.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and manages the main session key for chat context.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the overall talk mode functionality.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins speech recognition and chat session, requesting permissions as needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition, disables talk mode, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: suspendForBackground
methods.description: Temporarily suspends microphone activity without fully disabling talk mode.

methods.name: resumeAfterBackground
methods.description: Resumes talk mode after being suspended when returning from background.

methods.name: userTappedOrb
methods.description: Handles user interaction to stop speaking or interrupt speech output.

methods.name: beginPushToTalk
methods.description: Starts a push-to-talk session, managing permissions and recognition setup.

methods.name: endPushToTalk
methods.description: Terminates a push-to-talk session, processes the transcript, and resumes normal recognition.

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce
methods.description: Executes a single push-to-talk session with timeout control.

methods.name: cancelPushToTalk
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing push-to-talk session.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and initiates the speech recognition engine.

methods.name: restartRecognitionAfterError
methods.description: Attempts to restart recognition after encountering an error during continuous recognition.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops and cleans up current speech recognition tasks.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Processes transcribed speech, manages state, and triggers speech output or chat interactions.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles textual responses by parsing directives, performing TTS, and playing or synthesizing speech.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops current speech output, including incremental or full speech synthesis.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Decides if speech output should be interrupted based on current route and spoken text.

methods.name: applyDirective
methods.description: Applies voice and model directives to the speech synthesis configuration.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt text for chat based on transcript and interruptions.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the server and returns the session's run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatCompletion
methods.description: Waits for chat response completion, with timeout handling.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Retrieves the latest assistant response from chat history, considering timestamps.

methods.name: streamAssistant
methods.description: Streams assistant output incrementally, updating internal buffers.

methods.name: updateIncrementalContextIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates the context for incremental speech if it has changed or is uninitialized.
